title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot Cowork for GCC and GCC High
summary: Hold: the spending-policy path skips the Identity policy-type choice, and the web-search automation column incorrectly says no control is documented. Microsoft documents preview Graph automation for that policy in the global service used by GCC, but not GCC High. The roadmap facts and GCC licensing and capability descriptions are supported.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls: row 1
claims.claim: The route from Add spending policy to Select agents and services and Cowork needs no intervening policy-type choice.
claims.quote: Create and name the policy and then choose Identity as the scope. Use this option when you need to manage usage by users or groups for a supported service.
claims.fix: Replace the row's path, including the rendered table, with 'Copilot > Cost Management > Configuration > + Add spending policy > Policy scope > Identity > Specific groups > group > Select agents and services > Cowork'. Identity selects the policy type; Specific groups and group preserve the stated pilot scope. Retain the government-setup caveat. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/implement/usage-based-billing-manage-copilot-credits.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls: row 2
claims.claim: No API or automation is documented for the web-search policy.
claims.quote: These resources also support remediation and applyOnce. ... microsoft.copilot.allowwebsearch ... value ... 0 enables it in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat. 1 disables it in both.
claims.fix: Replace controls[1].api and its rendered gap with graph call 'POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors', docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/configurationmanagement-post-configurationmonitors?view=graph-rest-beta'. Add note: 'Preview TCM automation: set mode to applyOnce and include baseline.resources with resourceType microsoft.copilot.allowwebsearch, resourceVersion 1 and properties.value "0" to enable or "1" to disable. Only tenant-level policies are supported; the setting must not be configured in a group-level policy. Delegated access is required, with AI Administrator for the signed-in user and CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite delegated to TCM. Global service only, not GCC High.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources, https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-remediation-applyonce-resources and https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/deployments; the last confirms GCC uses the global Graph endpoint.
